title: Close editable high-low production with baked channels and fresh import verification
preconditions: high and low are independently authored in separate collections
component separation follows real assembly/material/motion boundaries
silhouette has already passed multiview review
required_observations: UV validity on every exported mesh
saved texture files and node hookup
action_policy: Preserve source modifiers and generate export geometry from evaluated state without destructively applying the source stacks.
Remove non-silhouette density from the low and compare high/low silhouettes in front, side, and top views.
Deliver BaseColor, Roughness, Metallic, and tangent Normal channels with correct color spaces and positive bake margins.
Import the delivery artifact in a clean process and verify mesh count, UVs, materials, images, and nonzero topology.
failure_predicates: high and low share mesh datablocks
fresh import fails or loses materials
recovery: author a genuinely lower independent cage
restore an editable source copy and keep modifiers live
rebake the failed channel with the correct active target and color space
repair export settings and repeat fresh import

sources.description: CG Thoughts demonstrates high-poly cleanup, low derivation, UV rectification/packing, cage baking, export, and engine normal orientation.

experiments.counterevidence: Pipeline completeness did not erase reference-shape omissions; the asset remains a simplified 5.5/10 fidelity reproduction.
